# EdgesDslBlock

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

fun interface [EdgesDslBlock](index.html)<in [T](index.html)>

A block that declares edges or routes on a [T](index.html) builder. In Kotlin, pass a lambda with the builder as its receiver. In Java, pass a lambda that takes the builder as an argument, with no `Unit` to return.
